title: WebSocket Close Handshake Example
description: Example of a clean WebSocket connection closure per RFC 6455 Section 7

statusCodes.1000: Normal Closure — endpoint purposely closed the connection
statusCodes.1001: Going Away — server going down or browser navigating away
statusCodes.1002: Protocol Error — endpoint received malformed data
statusCodes.1003: Unsupported Data — endpoint received unacceptable data type
statusCodes.1006: Abnormal Closure — connection was closed abnormally (no close frame)
statusCodes.1007: Invalid Frame Payload Data — text message contains invalid UTF-8
statusCodes.1008: Policy Violation — endpoint received a message violating policy
statusCodes.1009: Message Too Big — message is too large to process
statusCodes.1010: Mandatory Extension — client expected extension not negotiated
statusCodes.1011: Internal Error — server encountered unexpected condition
statusCodes.1015: TLS Handshake — TLS handshake failed (not sent in frame)
